capabilities: insert chart templates (pie, bar, radar, treemap, wordcloud, dual axes, line, tree graph)
build charts with a chart wizard
load chart data from internal or external CSV files
query chart data with Dataview dataviewjs methods
link chart clicks to Obsidian search operators
extras: Full documentation is generated elsewhere via Zread; the README itself is a feature outline with code-block placeholders. Desktop-only for external CSV import.
problem: Obsidian cannot render charts or data visualizations from note content and metadata on its own.

relations.evidence: Chart data by dataviewjs. Use command Charts View: Insert Template -> Dataviewjs Example (Column)

summary: Chart plugin that renders plots and graphs from note data, CSV files, or Dataview queries using Ant Design Charts.
